events.title: 장안에서 태어나다
events.description: 섬서 장안에서 태어났다. 어린 시절 아버지를 여의고 집안이 봉상부 미현 횡거진에 자리를 잡으면서, 뒷날 횡거선생이라 불리게 된다.
events.description_en: He was born in Chang'an, Shaanxi. His father died while he was young, and the family settled at Hengqu in Mei County, Fengxiang — the place that later gave him his name, Master Hengqu.

events.title: 범중엄에게 병법 상소를 올리다
events.title_en: He petitioned Fan Zhongyan on frontier defense
events.description: 스물한 살에 서북 방위를 맡은 범중엄에게 「변방구조」를 올려 서하 정벌군을 일으키자고 청했다. 범중엄은 유생이 병사의 일에 매달릴 필요가 없다며 그를 타이르고 『중용』을 읽으라고 권했다.
events.description_en: At twenty-one he submitted a memorial called Nine Proposals on the Frontier to Fan Zhongyan, who commanded the northwest defense, urging a campaign against the Western Xia. Fan told him a scholar had no need to chase soldiers' work and urged him to read the Zhongyong instead.

events.title: 불교와 도가를 거쳐 육경으로 돌아오다
events.title_en: He passed through Buddhism and Daoism and returned to the Six Classics
events.description: 범중엄의 권유 이후 한동안 불교와 노장사상을 탐구했다. 그 안에서 답을 찾지 못하고 다시 유가의 육경 연구로 돌아섰다.
events.description_en: Following Fan Zhongyan's advice, he spent years exploring Buddhist and Daoist thought. Finding no answer there, he turned back to the Confucian Six Classics.

events.title: 진사시에 급제하고 낙양에서 정호·정이를 만나다
events.title_en: He passed the jinshi exam and met the Cheng brothers in Luoyang
events.description: 1057년 진사시에 합격했다. 같은 해 낙양에서 정호·정이 형제와 『주역』을 놓고 토론했다.
events.description_en: He passed the jinshi examination in 1057. That year in Luoyang he discussed the Book of Changes with the brothers Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi.

events.title: 여공저의 추천으로 숭문원교서가 되다
events.title_en: He was appointed to the Chongwen Library on Lü Gongzhu's recommendation
events.description: 어사중승 여공저가 추천하자 신종이 그를 불러 만난 뒤 숭문원교서에 임명했다. 왕안석은 신법에 그를 끌어들이려 했으나 장재는 거리를 두었다.
events.description_en: The censor-in-chief Lü Gongzhu recommended him, and Emperor Shenzong summoned him and appointed him a collator at the Chongwen Library. Wang Anshi tried to draw him into the New Policies, but Zhang Zai kept his distance.

events.title: 관직을 버리고 횡거로 돌아가다
events.title_en: He resigned and returned to Hengqu
events.description: 아우 장전이 신법에 반대하다 왕안석과 정면으로 부딪히자 장재도 관직을 버리고 미현 횡거로 돌아갔다.
events.description_en: When his younger brother Zhang Jian clashed head-on with Wang Anshi over the New Policies, Zhang Zai resigned as well and returned to Hengqu in Mei County.

events.title: 횡거에서 정전제를 실험하다
events.title_en: He experimented with the well-field system at Hengqu
events.description: 제자들과 함께 땅을 사들여 『주례』의 정전법을 본떠 나누고, 땅 없는 농민에게 사전을 배분했다. 마을 수리 시설도 정비해 천 마지기 가까운 땅에 물을 댔다.
events.description_en: With his students he bought land and divided it after the well-field system described in the Rites of Zhou, giving private plots to farmers who had none. He also organized local irrigation works that watered nearly a thousand mu of fields.

events.title: 『정몽』을 완성해 제자들에게 전하다
events.title_en: He completed Correcting Youthful Ignorance and gave it to his students
events.description: 1076년 『정몽』을 완성해 제자들 앞에 내놓았다. 「서명」은 이 책의 한 편으로 실려, 뒷날 따로 떼어져 널리 읽혔다.
events.description_en: In 1076 he completed Correcting Youthful Ignorance and presented it to his disciples. The Western Inscription formed one chapter of this work and was later read as a separate text in its own right.

events.title: 조정의 부름을 받아 다시 상경하다
events.title_en: He was recalled to the capital
events.description: 1076년 말 신종의 부름으로 다시 조정에 올라 관직을 되찾았다.
events.description_en: Late in 1076 Emperor Shenzong recalled him to court, and he was restored to office.

events.title: 귀향길에서 병으로 죽다
events.title_en: He fell ill and died on the road home
events.description: 상경한 지 얼마 안 되어 병이 들어 다시 관직을 내놓았다. 횡거로 돌아가는 길에 세상을 떠나 고향 땅을 다시 밟지 못했다.
events.description_en: Soon after returning to office he fell ill and resigned again. He died on the road back to Hengqu, never reaching home again.
